'''Jenith''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chelloa]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. Along with the rest of Chelloa, Jenith was ruled by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], who ruled a remnant of the former [[Chagras Hegemony]] known as the [[Daimanate]]. During [[Operation Influx]], the [[City/Legends|town]] was raided by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike force and sustained large-scale devastation during a raid by [[Odion]]'s forces. Its population was 60,000 as of 1032 BBY.

Daiman treated the inhabitants as disposable, due to his narcissistic philosophy which posited himself as the Creator. Jenith was led by [[Gorlan Palladane]], who represented the slave workers. In retaliation for Palladane sheltering the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and supplying information on Daiman's [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] operations to Odion, Daiman's forces pillaged and burnt large areas of Jenith. However, they were stopped by Holt, who rescued Palladane from Daiman's [[Daiman's compound|alpine compound]] and made preparations to evacuate the population.
